root_cause: The build rewrites the whole main section of prijzen.html with tools/site-shell/apply-commercial-pricing-v1.mjs. The trial buttons were only added to the source page, so the live /prijzen kept the old Start buttons.
prevention: The trial buttons, the closing button, the trial explanation and the English translation (with lang=en) now live in the generator. A test fails when the generator stops emitting them. Before editing a page, check which build step writes it last.

evidence.runtime_status: generator run locally for the NL and EN page; production not yet verified after deploy

limitations: The yearly/monthly switch script in prijzen.html targets the source markup, not the generated cards
